joins.verified_count_note: Count CORRECTED 4,938 -> 5,390 and skeleton optimized, 2026-07-12. The published query matched ruralkg's postalCode literal RAW against spoke-okn's ZIP label. ruralkg stores New England ZIPs as 4 digits with the leading zero dropped (and a trailing space) - e.g. '1002 ' for 01002 Amherst MA - so those silently never matched. Stripping non-digits and left-padding to 5 recovers 452 more ZIPs. (Confirmed the delta is exactly the padding: without it the query still returns the old 4,938.) Same class of bug as the sawgraph undashed-CAS undercount. The query also now drives from ruralkg's postalCode (bound via IRI(CONCAT) - ruralkg stores the HTTPS schema.org IRI) instead of scanning spoke-okn.

joins.hinge_note: All 3,196 spoke-okn county nodes are present in ruralkg's censusCounty set; ruralkg's national county coverage fully contains spoke-okn's. ruralkg thus bridges spoke-okn county data to its rural health/justice indicators and (via the shared KWG county form) onward to the spatialkg hub.

joins.verified_count_note: Skeleton OPTIMIZED 2026-07-12: the published query scanned an entire graph with an unbound pattern (?s ?p ?o) and then regex-filtered the subject IRI, which exceeded the endpoint's server-side operation limit (HTTP 429) and so could never be re-verified. Rewritten to drive from the SMALL, TYPED side as a DISTINCT sub-SELECT and construct the other graph's IRI, turning the full scan into an index lookup. Same count, now runnable. Drives from ruralkg's censusCounty KWG IRIs.
